purpose: Single machine-readable source of truth for Nyforge feature status. README.md and engineering/ROADMAP.md are validated against this file by tools/check_feature_status.py (run in CI on every push). If a feature's status changes, update it HERE first, then reconcile the docs. Documentation can no longer drift from implementation the way the multi-select claim did.

ExpressionTests (28) + Nyrqis TestExpressions (13) + 5 conformance — NExpr (NUI-SCHEMA §7.2): deterministic tokenizer/parser/evaluator mirroring ui/nexpr.py and the rust/nyui crate (differential, byte-identical error messages); $expr: values in properties/overrides/action arguments and condition expression fields validated fail-closed (ER-NUI-021) and evaluated identically in NyForge/floor/crate; desktop.nstudio DND condition + clockTime format argument

BehaviorTextTests (16) — the compact text format parser/serializer for NuiBehavior (NuiBehaviorText): round-trip fidelity, nested AND/OR groups, action chains, expression-vs-equality leaves, parse errors; the Behaviors panel exposes a Visual/Code toggle so each behavior can be edited as readable text (WHEN/IF/DO) or as the node-graph, both surfaces producing the same NuiBehavior model

ResponsiveLayoutTests (8) + Nyrqis TestResponsiveLayout (12) + conformance (4) — anchors/min/max/aspect constraints in NuiLayout, resolved by ResponsiveLayout.Compute (floor resolve_layout mirrored, differential); both Nyrqis import gates validate the constraint fields; desktop.nstudio taskbar anchors/stretches/docks; breakpoint-specific visibility still future

features.tests: StateScopeTests (14) + Nyrqis TestStateScopes (13) + 2 conformance — the stateScopes section (NUI-SCHEMA §8.4): global/screen/component/session/persistent tables referenced as dotted scope.key names in expressions, conditions, bindings, and $expr: arguments; validated by both Nyrqis import gates (differential, byte-identical) and Nyforge (ER-NUI-023, scope-aware expression/condition/binding checks); FlattenedStates/IsStateKnown mirror the floor's resolve_states/_state_known; desktop.nstudio persistent.theme + session.clockTime wired to the theme toggle and DND title

AnimationTests (15) + Nyrqis TestAnimations (16) + 7 conformance — the document's animations section (NUI-SCHEMA §8.3): unique ids, targets that name components, non-empty properties, timing (duration/delay/repeat non-negative, easing linear|ease-in|ease-out|ease-in-out|steps, direction forward|reverse|alternate) and keyframes (list shape, offsets strictly increasing in [0, 1], each with a number/string/boolean value) validated by both Nyrqis import gates (differential, byte-identical) and Nyforge (ER-NUI-022); Nyrqis.Animation.Play (registry system action) references must name a declared animation; desktop.nstudio start-menu fade is a 3-keyframe curve wired to behavior_start_toggle; the animation timeline editor (Animations tab) edits each animation's timing, easing, and keyframes inline
